login.title: Operator Sign-In
login.subtitle: Screening results are tied to your operator account for this clinic's history.

disclaimer.bannerText: NETRA results are automated triage predictions for rural health centers. Final clinical diagnosis and treatment plans must always be confirmed by a licensed ophthalmologist.

patientInfo.title: Patient Screening Information
patientInfo.subtitle: Minimal, privacy-conscious data collection for rural Primary Health Centre (PHC) screening records.
patientInfo.patientIdHint: Anonymized token used for public dashboard displays.
patientInfo.diabetesDurationHint: Key risk coefficient for retinopathy progression.
patientInfo.screeningCenterPlaceholder: e.g. PHC Chandpur Health & Wellness Centre
patientInfo.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Gradual blurring of central vision, floaters
patientInfo.encryptedNote: Encrypted local session. Minimal patient identifiers.

upload.title: Upload Fundus Photograph
upload.subtitle: Provide a macula-centered or disc-centered 45° digital fundus photograph. This image is sent to the real Netra backend for inference — nothing here is simulated.
upload.sampleHeading: Or Load a Real IDRiD Sample Image:
upload.hint: The next step sends this image to the real backend, which runs the MATLAB quality gate (if available) before any grading happens.

quality.title: Image Quality Assessment
quality.subtitle: Real result from the backend's MATLAB quality gate — a rejected image never reaches the grading model.
quality.unavailableBody: This backend doesn't have the MATLAB Engine installed/running, so the quality gate step was skipped and grading proceeded Python-only. This is an honest "not available here", not a passed check.
quality.rejectedNotice: Image rejected by the quality gate — go back and try a different photograph.

enhancement.title: Image Enhancement
enhancement.subtitle: The MATLAB quality gate only runs enhancement for borderline-quality images, and feeds the result into grading/segmentation. This view shows the real result when it ran.
enhancement.noneTitle: No enhancement was applied to this image.
enhancement.noneBody: Either the image quality was already good enough, or the MATLAB engine isn't running on this backend. Grading still used the original image.

structures.title: Retinal Structure & Lesion Analysis
structures.subtitle: Vessel/optic-disc/fovea localization and candidate lesion detection, validated against real expert ground truth.
structures.unavailableTitle: Structural segmentation unavailable on this backend.
structures.unavailableBody: This requires the MATLAB Engine to be installed and licensed on the backend machine. Grading still ran normally — it doesn't depend on this.
structures.nvCaveat: Lower-confidence heuristic, not a validated detector — candidate locations are not reliable.

grading.title: DR Severity Assessment (ICDR Scale)
grading.subtitle: Real prediction from the trained model, using test-time augmentation.

explainable.title: Why did the AI predict this?
explainable.subtitle: A real heatmap computed from this specific image's gradients, showing which regions most influenced the model's prediction.
explainable.heatmapTitle: Grad-CAM Heatmap (real, computed for this image)
explainable.gradCamNote1: The heatmap highlights image regions with the strongest gradient signal for the predicted class — brighter areas contributed more to the model's decision.
explainable.gradCamNote2: It's a sanity-check tool to visually confirm the model is looking at the retina, not a formal explainability guarantee.
explainable.gradCamNote3: Compare against the structural segmentation overlay (previous step) for an independent second opinion.
explainable.footerNote: This is an AI-assisted screening result. Final clinical decisions must be made by a certified ophthalmologist.

referral.title: Clinical Triage & Referral
referral.subtitle: The referable decision is a separate, calibrated binary decision from the 5-way grade above.
referral.deploymentNote: Specific referral timeframe and tele-ophthalmology center routing are deployment configuration — not something this demo invents.
referral.protocolNoticeBody: This is a screening aid, not a diagnostic replacement. Final clinical decisions remain the sole responsibility of the ophthalmologist.

report.title: Clinical Tele-Screening Report
report.onScreenPreview: On-screen preview — the downloaded PDF is the real report
report.safetyNoticeBody: NETRA is an AI-assisted screening prototype, not a definitive diagnosis. Automated inferences must be confirmed through dilated slit-lamp ophthalmoscopy or clinical consultation by a certified ophthalmologist.

handout.title: Your Eye Screening Result

stage.NO_DR: No signs of diabetic eye disease were found today. Good news!
stage.MILD_NPDR: Early, mild changes were found in your eye.
stage.MODERATE_NPDR: Moderate changes were found in your eye. A specialist should examine you.
stage.SEVERE_NPDR: Serious changes were found in your eye. You need an urgent specialist check.
stage.PDR: Very serious changes were found. You need immediate specialist care to protect your eyesight.

timeframe.EMERGENCY: Go to the district eye hospital within 24-48 hours.
timeframe.HIGH: Visit the district eye hospital within 1-2 weeks.
timeframe.MEDIUM: Visit the eye hospital within 4 weeks.
timeframe.LOW: Visit the eye hospital within 2-3 months.
timeframe.ROUTINE: Your next routine eye check-up is in about 12 months.

handout.careDiet: Eat more vegetables, and use less sugar and oil.
handout.careSugar: Keep your blood sugar (HbA1c) under control with your doctor's help.
handout.careExercise: Walk or exercise for 30 minutes daily, if your doctor allows.
handout.careCheckup: Never skip your eye check-up, even if your vision feels fine.
handout.disclaimerBody: This sheet is general guidance from an AI-assisted screening. It is not a full diagnosis. Please follow your doctor's advice.
